semiconductor_relevance: High — Dongwon Parts Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing high-precision parts specifically for semiconductor equipment.
summary: Dongwon Parts Co., Ltd. has been a dedicated manufacturer of semiconductor parts since 1997, focusing on high-precision and difficult-to-machine components. The company offers a comprehensive range of services including material supply, machining, welding, and post-machining processes such as polishing and anodizing.

regional_presence.Korea: The company is based in Korea and has established specialized lines and systems for semiconductor manufacturing there.
